**Daily Summary – Krushn Gandhi | 11-03-2026**

Krushn had a full day split between academics and professional work at Stemious/Atalup. On the academic side, he completed a TOC tutorial covering regex generation from languages via NFA construction, NFA-to-DFA conversion, and state elimination — all clicked easily without friction. He also spent two hours in a group of five working through COI NPTEL MCQ quizzes; the session was productive during a 3-hour break between classes, using ChatGPT for uncertain questions, but final submission is pending a NotebookLM cross-check. His OOPD lecture on Java interfaces felt dry and redundant given his existing Flutter/service file experience.

On the professional side, he kicked off the week with a 1.5-hour scope alignment session with Gaurang Sir (Founder) and Nikil Sir (Tech Lead) at Stemious/Atalup, locking in two delivery milestones: a central demo dashboard by end of week, and fully agentic GTM and content creation pipelines by March 31st. He immediately shipped the demo dashboard on day one using Cursor, combining the existing platform and FFD reports code — output was nearly exactly as envisioned with only minor UI tweaks remaining. He also began building an EOD debrief bot using Claude, which is locally functional on Mac and in its second test run; deployment path (VM vs. Flutter app with local memory and notifications) is still undecided. A session where Vedant demoed Aurelius (a vibe-coded book tracking app) made a strong impression — the standout takeaway was Vedant's passion, attention to detail, and complete ownership of his work, which Krushn noted as a standard the whole team should aspire to.

Good follow-ups: Has the COI quiz been submitted after the NotebookLM check? What UI tweaks remain on the demo dashboard, and has it been shown to the team? Which deployment path was chosen for the EOD bot?
